verdict.rationale: Docs show firewall rules to control incoming traffic to instances (implying port-level exposure), and Kubernetes docs explicitly walk through exposing a vLLM server via a Service and Ingress for external access. Private networking between instances is evidenced for 1-Click Clusters and Managed Kubernetes via GPUDirect RDMA/InfiniBand and shared persistent storage across nodes. However, there's no explicit doc for generic on-demand single instances on how to open arbitrary ports/serve apps outside the K8s/cluster context, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of these networking claims. Missing for 10: explicit port-exposure guidance for standalone ODC instances, independent verification of private networking performance/reliability, and any community corroboration of these specific capabilities.
